# scenario registration_join_message: what the core told the UI, and where it ended up.
# Recorded from internal/irc + internal/state. Regenerate with
# `go test ./internal/transcript -update`, and read doc.go before you do.

stream registration
	conn "connecting"
	conn "ready"
	conn "registering"
	rail
	self <eco>
	status server "- irc.test Message of the Day -"
	status server "- testsrv, a scripted fake server"
	status server "Connected! You are eco"
	status server "End of /MOTD command."
	status server "This server was created at the beginning of the test"
	status server "Welcome to the TestNet IRC Network eco"
	status server "Your host is irc.test, running version testsrv-1"

stream 0 C: join #eco

stream 2 S: :eco!eco@test JOIN #eco / :irc.test 332 eco #eco :a channel for testing / :irc.test 353 eco = #eco :@alice eco +bob / :irc.test 366 eco #eco :End of /NAMES list.
	members #eco "alice(@),bob(+),eco"
	rail
	status #eco "You joined #eco"
	topic #eco "a channel for testing"

stream 5 S: @msgid=m1 :alice!alice@test PRIVMSG #eco :hello eco, welcome
	msg #eco <alice> [highlight] "hello eco, welcome"
	unread #eco

stream 6 S: @msgid=m1 :alice!alice@test PRIVMSG #eco :hello eco, welcome

stream 7 S: :bob!bob@test PRIVMSG #eco :a line with no msgid
	msg #eco <bob> "a line with no msgid"
	unread #eco

stream 8 S: @msgid=n1 :alice!alice@test NOTICE #eco :a notice about economy
	msg #eco <alice> [notice] "a notice about economy"
	unread #eco

stream 9 S: @msgid=a1 :alice!alice@test PRIVMSG #eco :\x01ACTION waves at eco\x01
	msg #eco <alice> [action,highlight] "waves at eco"
	unread #eco

stream 10 S: @msgid=p1 :carol!carol@test PRIVMSG eco :private hello
	msg carol <carol> [highlight] "private hello"
	rail
	unread carol

stream 11 S: @msgid=p2 :CAROL!carol@test PRIVMSG eco :and again
	msg carol <CAROL> [highlight] "and again"
	unread carol

stream 12 S: @msgid=m5 :alice!alice@test PRIVMSG #ECO :cased target
	msg #eco <alice> "cased target"
	unread #eco

stream 13 S: @msgid=s1 :irc.test NOTICE eco :a server notice
	msg server <irc.test> [notice] "a server notice"
	unread server

state #eco topic="a channel for testing" modes="" key="" members=[alice(@) bob(+) eco]
	status #eco "You joined #eco"
	msg #eco <alice> [highlight] "hello eco, welcome"
	msg #eco <bob> "a line with no msgid"
	msg #eco <alice> [notice] "a notice about economy"
	msg #eco <alice> [action,highlight] "waves at eco"
	msg #eco <alice> "cased target"

state carol topic="" modes="" key="" members=[]
	msg carol <carol> [highlight] "private hello"
	msg carol <CAROL> [highlight] "and again"

state server topic="" modes="" key="" members=[]
	status server "Welcome to the TestNet IRC Network eco"
	status server "Your host is irc.test, running version testsrv-1"
	status server "This server was created at the beginning of the test"
	status server "- irc.test Message of the Day -"
	status server "- testsrv, a scripted fake server"
	status server "End of /MOTD command."
	status server "Connected! You are eco"
	msg server <irc.test> [notice] "a server notice"
